function.arguments: {"observation": "The `channel` variable is not randomly assigned — the email campaign was deliberately targeted at existing high-value customers (specifically, `loyal` and `returning` segments). The `customer_segment` distribution is highly imbalanced between channels: email has 131 loyal and 131 returning, while paid_search has only 26 loyal and 153 returning. This imbalance means raw conversion rate differences are confounded by customer segment.", "implication": "A simple difference in conversion rates between channels is not a valid estimate of the campaign effect. The observed difference may reflect segment differences rather than the effect of the email channel. To estimate the campaign effect, we must adjust for `customer_segment` — e.g., by stratifying or using a model. Otherwise, the estimate is biased."}
function.name: note_finding
